-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolatebuildtest

go 1.26
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"isolate"
)

func run(name string) {
	program, ok := isolate.LookupProgram(name)
	if !ok {
		panic("missing program " + name)
	}
	instance, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: program, Input: []byte(name)})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := instance.Start(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	select {
	case command := <-instance.Commands():
		fmt.Println(name, string(command.Payload))
		command.Reply([]byte("ok"), nil)
	case <-instance.Done():
		panic("program returned without a command")
	}
	<-instance.Done()
}

func main() {
	run("orders")
	run("orders")
	run("billing")
}
-- orders/isolate.json --
{"name":"orders"}
-- orders/main.go --
package main

import (
	"example.org/isolatebuildtest/shared"
	"isolate"
	"strconv"
)

var counter = 40 + shared.Next()

func main() {
	counter++
	input := <-isolate.Inbox()
	payload := append([]byte("orders:"), input...)
	payload = append(payload, ':')
	payload = append(payload, strconv.Itoa(counter)...)
	payload = append(payload, ':')
	payload = append(payload, strconv.Itoa(shared.Next())...)
	response, err := isolate.Call(1, payload)
	if err != nil || string(response) != "ok" {
		panic("orders reply")
	}
}
-- billing/isolate.json --
{"name":"billing"}
-- billing/main.go --
package main

import (
	"example.org/isolatebuildtest/shared"
	"isolate"
	"strconv"
)

func main() {
	input := <-isolate.Inbox()
	payload := append([]byte("billing:"), input...)
	payload = append(payload, ':')
	payload = append(payload, strconv.Itoa(shared.Next())...)
	response, err := isolate.Call(1, payload)
	if err != nil || string(response) != "ok" {
		panic("billing reply")
	}
}
-- shared/state.go --
package shared

var counter = 100

func Next() int {
	counter++
	return counter
}
